annotations.title: Clear all draft competencies, leaving the section empty

description: Clear every competency from a draft, leaving the stage deliberately empty — deterministic, no AI generation. Prunes the behavioral anchors of every cleared competency in the same write and reports the pruned ids. The emptied draft cannot be published as a new plan; bind the emptying onto an already-live plan with modify_active. Optional source_stage {stage: competencies, version} returns 409 when stale.
name: yardstick_interview_plan_drafts_clear_competencies
